title: What is the best AI for sound effects?
author: pagancrusher
selftext: What is the best AI for sound effects that I can use in my game? Whether it be weapon sounds or stuff like ambience. I'm currently using Elevenlabs but they only produced a handful of somewhat good sound effects.

comments.author: MichaelEmouse
comments.body: I made Claude Code build me a custom audio lab with a bunch of sound categories, parameters to change and interactive evolution.

replies.author: MichaelEmouse
replies.body: I'm at work right now but unless I forget, I'll send you a link within a day and you can have an idea of what that looks like.

replies.author: clydeagain
replies.body: The idea was enough to inspire me but more reference picture would help visualize better with added details I might've missed so that'll be great!!

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: If ElevenLabs only gives a few good sounds, I would generate short dry clips and layer them. For a weapon sound, keep the mechanical click, impact and tail separate. It makes variation easier, and you can test the result at game volume with music playing.

replies.author: sanctumreborn
replies.body: this is the way OP - you get much better results

comments.author: imlo2
comments.body: Stable Audio 3 has also specialized models for sound effects, some of those work quite well, I've used those via ComfyUI locally, and have Claude or Codex do the calls via API. But the results can vary a lot depending on what you try to do, but still I'd say it's useful and doesn't cost anything to run if you have the hardware etc.

comments.author: Cairhien
comments.body:
I help run https://soundza.com/developers - we have a 100% free MCP/API that lets you generate sound effects, max 250/week so it's pretty generous. It uses stable audio 3 plus some special processing layers. We also have a large library of real effects, and support for Google's lyria model for background music. It's all free.

If you're interested, I'm also working on a new model specifically tuned for video game sound effects. It's not ready for public release yet but we're looking for folks to try it in a private beta and give feedback. Feel free to dm me if interested.

comments.author: LadyDemura
comments.body: Have you tried layering instead of hunting for one perfect generation? I'll make like 8 variations in ElevenLabs and stack two or three for weapons, same as with Magnific upscales where the first pass is almost never the one I keep.
